model.label: Claude Opus 5.5 as the agent through the tool CLI (OpenCode subagent; same tools and prompt, not the app's own agent loop)
model.note: The agent ran its own loop through ngpvan-agent-tool; its tool calls were replayed here through the real server to record what VAN returned and what the model saw. Latency is replay time, not model time.

data_note: All data is fictional: the Riverbend program, its people, events and lists are made up. Phone numbers are in the 555-0100 to 555-0199 range reserved for fiction, and emails use example.org. The VAN API here is a local fake that follows the documented response shapes.

card.description: An MCP server that lets an AI assistant answer organizer questions from NGP VAN without seeing people's contact details.
points: Read-only unless a write tool is turned on in the config.
Phone numbers, emails, street addresses and birth dates are removed in code before the model sees a result.
A write has to be a dry run first, and sending it needs the dry run's token.
Every tool call writes one audit line, and the API key never appears in it.
Works with Claude or an open model through any MCP client.
Everything in this demo is made-up data for a fictional program.

questions.question: How many doors are on Northside's turf lists, and which turf is biggest?
questions.note: VAN's API doesn't report doors knocked. This counts the doors on the saved lists Northside cut as turf, using VAN's own door count for each list.
